evidence: In 3d_top, 3d_iso and 3d_iso_back every body (terminal block, SOIC-8, inductor, SOT-223, headers, passives) has visible board surface between it and its neighbors with no intersecting or stacked bodies.
Both iso views show all bodies seated flush on the PCB surface with no floating, sunken, or tilted parts.

Zoomed 3d_top shows the two two-pad footprints below D1 (R1/R2 per the 2D refs) are bare pads with no component bodies at all, so body-on-pad placement cannot be confirmed for them; all other bodies are centered on their footprints.

Terminal block J1 sits at the board edge with its wire opening facing outward, vertical-entry headers J2/J3 are upright near the opposite edge, there are no relays, and the lone polarized part D1 follows the left-to-right power flow.
Not applicable; no RF module or antenna keepout exists on this board.

The buck chain reads as an ordered bottom row, but the regulator group is scattered with no grid alignment (C4 floats well above U2, C5/C6 offset diagonally right, C2 hangs below, J3 stranded toward the corner) and the entire upper half of the board is dead space.
